quiz_categories.name: Surah Names
quiz_categories.description: Test your knowledge of Surah names and their meanings

quiz_categories.name: Prophets in Quran
quiz_categories.description: Questions about the prophets mentioned in the Quran

questions.question: What is the first Surah in the Quran?
questions.question_ar: ما هي أول سورة في القرآن؟
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah (The Opening) is the first chapter of the Quran
questions.explanation_ar: الفاتحة (الافتتاحية) هي السورة الأولى من القرآن

questions.question: Which is the longest Surah in the Quran?
questions.question_ar: ما هي أطول سورة في القرآن؟
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah (The Cow) is the longest chapter with 286 verses
questions.explanation_ar: البقرة هي أطول سورة بـ 286 آية

questions.question: Which Surah is known as the 'Heart of the Quran'?
questions.explanation: Surah Ya-Sin is often referred to as the 'Heart of the Quran'
questions.explanation_ar: سورة يس غالباً ما يُشار إليها بـ 'قلب القرآن'

questions.question: Who was the first prophet mentioned in the Quran?
questions.question_ar: من هو أول نبي ذُكر في القرآن؟
questions.explanation: Prophet Adam (AS) was the first prophet and the first human
questions.explanation_ar: النبي آدم عليه السلام كان أول نبي وأول إنسان

questions.question: How many Surahs are in the Quran?
In how many years was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed over a period of 23 years
